name: sdlc-workspace
description: SDLC — a local code-intelligence engine, a desktop app that installs it, and thin companion plugins for coding harnesses.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @sdlc/protocol && npm run build -w @sdlc/scan-core && npm run build -w @sdlc/engine && npm run build -w @sdlc/mcp-bridge && npm run build -w @sdlc/desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @sdlc/protocol && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @sdlc/protocol && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.eval: npm run build -w @sdlc/protocol && npm run build -w @sdlc/scan-core && npm run build -w @sdlc/engine && npm run eval -w @sdlc/engine --
scripts.eval:joern: npm run build -w @sdlc/protocol && npm run build -w @sdlc/engine && npm run eval:joern -w @sdlc/engine --
